|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ボシェックはこのシニティーンの男性に“ブレイニアック（頭でっかち）”というあだ名をつけた。その名にふさわしく、彼はハイパースペースの座標を自分の頭で計算できる。レイアの脱獄作戦も、彼が立案していたらさぞかし・・・</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Brainiac.

'''Card text:'''
*Power = √3(X-Y)+2(A-B)+π (minimum power = 1).
X = Dark Side cards in hand.
Y = Light Side cards in hand.
A = total Dark icons in play.
B = total Light icons in play.
π = 3.141592653589793238462643383...

'''Lore:'''
BoShek nicknamed this male Siniteen "Brainiac" (big-headed). True to the name, he can calculate hyperspace coordinates in his head. If he had planned Leia's jailbreak, surely...

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore wonders what if he had planned Leia's jailbreak; the English quotes BoShek.
